concerns.text: Task T004 loads public datasets but does not emit the mandated warning "Public dataset lacks concurrent load labels. Manual Golden Set (T007g) is required." This violates FR-001 which requires an explicit warning when load labels are absent.
Task T032 only writes a hysteresis config file; there is no task that implements the hysteresis controller decision‑making logic required by FR-004.
No task addresses multiple‑comparison / family‑wise‑error correction required by FR-007. The specification mandates this correction when >1 hypothesis test is run.

SC-004 (computational‑resource compliance) is not covered by any task. The plan mentions profiling training time (T058) but never verifies the 2‑core, ≤7 GB RAM, ≤6 h wall‑clock limits for the whole pipeline.

Constitution principle VI requires validation code and metrics to be stored under `code/validation/`. Current tasks store `model_metrics.json` in `data/processed/`, violating the load‑model‑validation governance.
Constitution principle III (Data Hygiene) is unmet: there is no task that computes or records checksums for raw data files, nor logs them in the project state YAML.
Constitution principle I (Reproducibility) is unmet: no task pins random seeds or provides a deterministic seed‑setting utility, risking non‑reproducible runs.
